title: Norwegian Baked Salmon Gratin
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines the flavors of Norway with the comfort of a gratin. The salmon is baked to perfection in a creamy sauce.
instructions: Line a baking dish with parchment paper.
Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the grated Gruyere cheese until melted and smooth.
Place the salmon fillets in the prepared baking dish.
Pour the cream sauce over the salmon.
Top with parsley and bake for 12-15 minutes or until the salmon is cooked through.
